voices.note: הלל הבבלי, ששימש שני גדולי הדור שמעיה ואבטליון
the Bnei Beteira, from whom this halakha was hidden (נתעלמה)
Hillel's teachers; subjects of the מקובלני attribution at 66a.8

props.gloss_en: the paschal offering overrides Shabbat -- Hillel's conclusion, held by both derivations and finally by the Bnei Beteira
the daily tamid offering overrides Shabbat -- the source-side premise both derivations lean on (the two-hundred pesachim of 66a.3 are the year's tamid and musaf offerings)
'the Shabbat olah on its Shabbat, beside the olah of the tamid' -- by implication, the tamid is offered on Shabbat: the verse that actually grounds the premise

one may not derive a gezera shava on his own authority -- the principle that explains why the Bnei Beteira could not have reached the GS unaided, and why Hillel offered them the KV they COULD have derived. A principle prop plus glosses, not a restrictions: block (predeclared): it does not bar this GS, which Hillel held by reception from Shemaya and Avtalyon
leave Israel be: if they are not prophets, they are sons of prophets -- Hillel's warrant for letting the forgotten halakha surface from practice

one who forgot to bring a knife before Shabbat: if his pesach is a lamb he sticks it in its wool, if a kid, between its horns -- the halakha Hillel had heard and forgotten (הלכה זו שמעתי ושכחתי, 66a.7)

schemas.gloss_en: נאמר מועדו בפסח ונאמר מועדו בתמיד: מה מועדו האמור בתמיד דוחה את השבת, אף מועדו האמור בפסח דוחה את השבת. Narrated first (66a.4) but argued SECOND per the stam's 66a.11 reconstruction (והדר אמר להו גזירה שוה); it is the derivation that stands

ועוד, קל וחומר הוא: ומה תמיד שאין ענוש כרת דוחה את השבת, פסח שענוש כרת אינו דין שדוחה את השבת. ONE middah, TWO loci: uttered at 66a.5, re-quoted by the stam at 66a.11 (אמר מר: ועוד קל וחומר) -- not double-minted (predeclared). Per the stam's reconstruction it was argued FIRST: קל וחומר אמר להו ברישא ופרכוה

grounds.gloss_en: איכא למיפרך: מה לתמיד שכן תדיר וכליל — the tamid is both constant and wholly burnt, stringencies the pesach lacks, so its Shabbat-override cannot be exported a fortiori. Voiced by the stam at 66a.11 and, in the narrative, by the Bnei Beteira themselves at 66a.12: אמרו ליה קל וחומר פריכא הוא (ופרכוה, 66a.11). UNANSWERED -- the KV dies; the GS block carries no trace of this ground. tadir/kalil are declared gloss-only debt (trigger: a Zevachim תדיר וקודם sugya; and `kalil` already names a different, Chullin-24a sense)

objections.gloss_en: ותמיד גופיה מנלן דדחי שבת? אילימא משום דכתיב ביה במועדו — פסח נמי הא כתיב ביה מועדו! if מועדו itself carried the override, the Bnei Beteira would have needed no Hillel for the pesach either

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא מועדו לא משמע ליה, הכא נמי מועדו לא משמע להו: אלא אמר קרא עולת שבת בשבתו על עולת התמיד — מכלל דתמיד קרבה בשבת (= p_olat_shabbat): the word did not signify to them; the premise rests on the explicit verse
